title: Kingdom of Ash
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: The final book of Throne of Glass. The long war reaches its decisive stage as the heroine and her allies fight to end a threat that has hung over their world for years.
readIf: you want to finish the series with a very long, satisfying showdown.
skipIf: you are new to the series or find extended war and cruelty hard to read.

pairings.reason: The author’s other series finale to its biggest war, with a similar mix of romance and battle.
A shorter, grimmer finale in which a long fight for freedom is costly.
For readers who like mythic, large-scale fantasy history and want something far weightier.
